name: Xbox Remote Play
requires: An Xbox on the same network, with remote features on
pitch: Play the games on your own Xbox, streamed to your PS3 over your home network.
description: Stream your Xbox Series X|S or Xbox One straight to your PS3. Wake your console from the couch, pick up where you left off and play with your PS3 controller, all over your own network.
whatsNew: Its own Remote Play icon, and the Xbox Series X behind its page in DeepHub.
